O1: At least 10 energy legislative (primary and secondary) acts developed, amended and /or approved including gender sensitive energy policy documents
O2: 1 energy coordination mechanism established and functional 5 institutions in the energy and renewables sectors benefiting from individual, institutional, and technological capacity building
O3: 200,000 of consumers reached through EU-funded awareness raising campaigns on the impact of consumption

O1: - NECP development has been initiated. - A preliminary draft normative act on emergency situation in the natural gas sector has been drafted - The first draft of the Regulation on establishment and functioning of the Governance Energy Mechanism and Climate Action and the draft Regulatory Impact Assessment have been developed - A mechanism for the payment of heating services in the case of apartments disconnected from the district heating in accordance with the reasoning of the Constitutional Court Decision nr. 4 as of 3 March 2022 developed -The Law on Energy Vulnerability Reduction Fund that provides a fair distribution of energy compensations/subsidies among the vulnerable approved.
O2: - 1 energy coordination mechanism established and functional - The functional analysis and the Regulation of functioning of the Agency for Energy Efficiency was developed enabling proper implementation of energy policies and regulations - 5 institutions in the energy and renewables sectors benefitted from individual, institutional, and technological capacity building - Concept and implementation mechanism of the Energy Vulnerability Reduction Fund developed and is in use by the Government and end-users -The Energy Vulnerability Reduction Information System developed and is in use that allows on-bill compensations for vulnerable consumers (https://compensatii.gov.md/). - 100 biomass heating systems in public institutions inspected and prepared for the heating season. - 100 operators of biomass thermal powerplants trained.
O3: -A National Nudging Programme on reducing the energy consumption (electricity sector) with the key energy providers was conducted, reaching out to approx. 700,000 households. The Nudging programme has led to an average decrease of 1.33% in energy consumption among the targeted households . -2000 schoolchildren from rural localities were presented thematic shows on energy and resource efficiency and renewable energy -Over 300 schoolchildren aged 10-16 years participated in a drawing competition on promotion of renewable energy, energy efficiency and CO2 reduction

title.narrative: Center of Information under AEE reactivated and operational.

description.narrative: The Action will deploy a series of tools to nudge people to act more energy efficiently and increase their literacy in energy security area ( serveys, sensemaking, video testimonials, etc.) . The indicator under this result will measure the increased interest of the citizens on relevant information leading to efficient use of energy resources. It will also measure the extend to which the Center for Information under AEE is ready to act as a one-stop shop information hub.
